description: This file defines the interface IDecryptionService for a decryption service in the Rialto media server component. It declares virtual methods related to decrypting media buffers, managing key sessions, and querying key system types.
external_methods: MediaKeyErrorStatus decrypt(int32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstCaps*)

classes.name: IDecryptionService
classes.description: An interface class for decryption services, providing methods for decrypting media data, managing key sessions, and querying key system types.

methods.name: ~IDecryptionService
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IDecryptionService interface.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on encrypted media buffers. There are two overloads: one for simple decryption and one with additional parameters for subsample decryption.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key session uses the PlayReady key system.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a key session.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a key session.

calls: MediaKeyErrorStatus decrypt(int32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstBuffer*, GstBuffer*, uint32_t, GstCaps*)
